decision.observation: Braking reduced the car to 13 mph in first gear. It remains centered on the wet asphalt, with a gentle leftward section immediately ahead and trees beyond both edges.
decision.hypothesis: A brief straight throttle input will maintain the current safe line at low speed; steering can be reassessed as the car reaches the bend.
decision.memory: Braking from 29 to 13 mph was effective. Use very short steering corrections and brake before tight sections. Black screens have been recovered with Escape, a wait, and sometimes Enter.
